# Terraform Cloudflare Zone

> Zones, DNS records, DNSSEC, TLS settings, custom hostnames, and cache configuration.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [cache](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/cache): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/cache`
- [custom-hostname](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/custom-hostname): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/custom-hostname`
- [dns-record](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/dns-record): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/dns-record`
- [dnssec](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/dnssec): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/dnssec`
- [settings](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/settings): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/settings`
- [ssl](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-zone/tree/main/modules/ssl): `terraform-cf-modules/zone/cloudflare//modules/ssl`
